title: unified-rollouts: extend auto-rollback to multi-SLO metric matching and configurable windows
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: current auto-rollback behavior for unified rollouts evaluates a single primary metric (e.g. error_rate) using a fixed window and threshold. This PR extends the rollout controller and policy engine to support multi-SLO metric matching (latency, error rate, and quality regressions), configurable aggregation windows, and boolean/weighted decision rules so teams can express combined failure modes for canary/A-B/shadow rollouts. The change includes: 1) a policy schema extension enabling an ordered list of SLO checks with operator/threshold/window; 2) controller-side evaluation that computes per-metric windows, applies aggregation (p95/p99/mean) and applies weighted scoring when specified; 3) rollout decision engine update so a single evaluation can trigger immediate rollback, partial rollback, or escalate to manual review depending on configured severity; 4) migration path for existing auto-rollback policies (backwards-compatible defaults); 5) integration tests and unit tests for metric combination semantics; 6) docs and examples for canary/A-B/shadow policies. This PR is intended to reduce false positives where short-lived latency spikes shouldn't roll back a model but sustained quality regressions should. See linked Linear tickets for product acceptance criteria.

merge_commit_message:
unified-rollouts: extend auto-rollback to multi-SLO metric matching and configurable windows

Add policy schema, controller evaluation, migration handler, tests and docs.
release_notes: Feature: rollout auto-rollback now supports multi-metric SLO policies (latency, error rate, quality). Teams can configure aggregation windows, operator types, and weighted decision rules. Backwards-compatible migration included.
tests_added: integration tests for mixed SLO aggregators and decision scoring; unit tests for evaluator and migration handler
migration_steps: On deploy, the migration handler will upgrade legacy single-metric policies to the new schema with default weights=1 and windows copied from previous settings. No manual intervention required. For custom policies, review upgraded policies in the Console under Rollouts > Policies.
notes: CI initially showed a transient test failure (TestRolloutStability) during a prometheus scrape race; rerun succeeded. Observability dashboard added to help SREs visualize multi-SLO evaluations per rollout.
